...I guess I'm just here because... I can’t really keep my words in a straight line anymore.

Does it feel like your thoughts are racing through your mind faster than you can keep up with them?
I don't think so. They aren't really... going fast. Just... messy, I guess. I don't know.
Have you been hearing any voices or sounds that other people around you don't seem to hear?
No. I haven't heard anything like that. Just... normal sounds.
Have you felt like people are watching you or talking about you behind your back?

...Yeah. I mean, they are. The supervisors. 

They changed my shifts around. I know they're watching me on the unit cameras... just waiting to see if I do something unsafe. People keep saying it's just, you know, staffing shortages, but... I know what they're doing.
How long have you felt that your supervisors are watching you like that?
It's been... a while. Maybe... a little over a year? Yeah, like a year and a month, I think. Since it all started getting weird.
